summary: To use the default execution environment on remote execution nodes, create a pull secret (username, password, url registry.redhat.io) in the controller namespace, set spec.ee_pull_credentials_secret and restart the operator pod.
questions: Remote execution nodes cannot pull the execution environment image
Create a pull secret for execution environments on OpenShift

answer_card.title: Pull secret for remote execution nodes
answer_card.answer_md:
```
oc create secret generic ee-pull-secret \
  --from-literal=username=<username> \
  --from-literal=password=<password> \
  --from-literal=url=registry.redhat.io
oc edit automationcontrollers <instance name>
```

Add to the spec:

```
spec:
  ee_pull_credentials_secret: ee-pull-secret
```

Then restart the automation controller Operator pod.
